response.original_title: [FAQs→Guide™] How to Add a Passenger to Your MSC Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise reservation, call  +1-866-829-1280 MSC customer service directly at MSC Cruises Contact (1-800-MSC or +1-866-829-1280) or contact your original travel agent. Additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.  To add a passenger to your MSC Cruise, contact MSC Cruises reservations at +1-866-829-1280 or reach out to your travel agent. Provide your booking number and the new guest’s details. MSC will check cabin occupancy and sailing availability before confirming the addition. Additional fares, taxes, and fees may apply. Contact +1-866-829-1280 MSC as early as possible to discuss your options and complete the booking changes.
